Page.* commands now go through cdpPageCall/cdpPageSession: Target.attachToTarget{flatten:true}, command sent with the returned sessionId and no targetId param; getPageMetrics uses Performance.enable/getMetrics/disable (Chrome serves no Page.getMetrics). Failures throw typed StealthCoreBrowserError. Proven by test/unit/domains-storage/transport.spec.ts, domains.spec.ts [fs-181][fs-182], page.spec.ts.

BrowserService.getWindowBounds resolves windowId via Browser.getWindowForTarget then sends Browser.getWindowBounds{windowId} on one connection; errors typed. Proven by domains.spec.ts [F147] and browser.spec.ts.
NetworkService cookie reads attach a page session (given or first open page); no page is TARGET_NOT_FOUND; failures reject instead of [] . Proven by domains.spec.ts [F148], network.spec.ts.

Requests are tracked per requestId (Set) and scoped to the navigation loaderId via the requestWillBeSent loaderId, so a redirect re-announcing the same requestId counts once and returns to zero after one loadingFinished. settle.spec.ts: redirected request, stale-loader request, followed redirect loader.

transport.ts now fetches /json/version via getRawVersion (cdpFetch + assertSameEndpoint), so a debugger URL for another host is CDP_BAD_RESPONSE before any socket opens. Proven by transport.spec.ts 'refuses a debugger URL that points at another host'.

createPageTarget and createIsolatedPageTarget dispose/close the freshly created context/target when the /json/list poll throws. Proven by targets.spec.ts 'no target, context or socket leaks when listing fails'.

The version fetch (transport, BrowserService.getVersion) and TargetService.listPageTargets share targets.ts cdpFetch/cdpJson: 5 s abort signal -> CDP_TIMEOUT, non-2xx -> CDP_BAD_RESPONSE. Proven by transport.spec.ts, browser.spec.ts, target.spec.ts.

One cleanup() clears subscribers, deadline/grace/inflight/ui timers and the abort listener on resolve, abort and navigate failure. settle.spec.ts asserts vi.getTimerCount()==0 after abort and failed navigation and removeEventListener on resolve.

Page.navigate loaderId no longer overwrites a newer main-frame commit seen before the reply (committedLoaderId); a same-document navigation (no loaderId) rejects PAGE_SETTLE_FAILED (reason same-document) instead of ignoring every event until the deadline. settle.spec.ts covers both.
createPageTargetIdleShutdown documents its options and logs a warning when shutDownChrome is set without onShutdown.

closePageTarget, hideAllWindows, reveal and dispose close their CdpSession in finally, so a rejected Target.closeTarget or a failing listing leaves no socket open. Proven by targets.spec.ts leak tests.
Chrome-time conversion keeps sub-second precision and Google support dir is resolved per platform (googleSupportDir).
